headline: Maui Board of Water Supply

meeting.summary: Without a quorum, the Board of Water Supply heard the desalination report should be released by the next meeting, with public hearings in early August.
meeting.recap: The board did not have a quorum, the number of members needed to vote.[[0:01:33]] A member of the public asked the water and planning departments to meet on a regular basis.[[0:03:53]] An East Maui update said a July 24 Board of Land and Natural Resources meeting was postponed.[[0:08:06]] A board member asked when the desalination (turning salt water into fresh water) report would be released.[[0:12:36]] The director said the report should be redacted, with sensitive parts removed, by the next meeting and then released.[[0:13:08]] The director said public hearings on desalination are set for early August.[[0:13:46]] The board member said public meetings should not happen before the report is released.[[0:15:43]] The director said a West Maui well development schedule should be presented in September.[[0:16:26]] The director said this fiscal year's capital budget money will update the study so it may qualify for federal funding.[[0:28:22]] Without a quorum, approval of the minutes and a draft letter moved to the next meeting.[[0:31:59]] A board member asked to add the West Maui well schedule and desalination report release to a future agenda.[[0:33:17]]
decided: With no objections, the chair moved approval of the minutes and the draft letter to the end of the meeting.
With no quorum and no objections, approval of the minutes and the draft letter was moved to the next meeting.
meeting.next: The director said a desalination grant application would be done early next calendar year if the department decides to go ahead. The director said there will be more public outreach before any desalination plant moves forward. The chair said the TIG will present recommendations on a received letter at an upcoming meeting. A board member asked to add an item on the need for a Department of Water Supply verification letter for subdivision development.
